behaviors.precondition: An editable scene has either a selected target node, a scene root, or an existing usable PVController; the game is not running.
behaviors.public_action: Invoke the registered Flow F4 action or the equivalent Enter Flow button.
behaviors.expected_result: Flujo reuses one compatible controller or creates exactly one undoable scene-owned PVController, selects it, and enters FLOW; Undo and Redo preserve the scene history.
invariants: No duplicate controller is created by repeated requests.
GAME never consumes F4 for editor interaction.
A second F4 leaves FLOW without deleting the controller.

behaviors.precondition: The Flow dock has less vertical space than the complete selected-item editor requires.
behaviors.public_action: Scroll the Flow dock with its native vertical ScrollContainer.
behaviors.expected_result: The vertical range exceeds the visible page and the final configuration controls can be brought fully into view.
invariants: One vertical scroll surface contains the complete configuration area.
Horizontal resizing remains native and unconstrained.
Selection and model state are not changed by scrolling.

behaviors.precondition: A schema 3 collection row or one of its public editor controls is active.
behaviors.public_action: Use public selection, Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Escape, F2, popup, Move, Undo, or Redo interactions.
behaviors.expected_result: The selected stable ID and current dock context remain aligned while focus follows only deliberate user navigation.
invariants: Selection identity never depends on the visible name or row index.
Rebuilds do not retain callbacks to detached controls.
Automatic model changes do not steal focus from unrelated editor controls.

behaviors.precondition: A Flow collection row remains semantically selected while keyboard focus belongs to another editor control.
behaviors.public_action: Move focus away from the selected ItemList without changing selection.
behaviors.expected_result: The stable-ID selection remains semantically active; a stronger cross-theme visual shade is explicitly deferred.
invariants: No focus is stolen to manufacture a visual indication.
Operations continue to target the selected stable ID.

behaviors.area: Delete, Undo, Redo, selection, and focus
behaviors.precondition: A deletable Method, Variable, Process, Timer, or supported block is selected through the real Inspector/plugin/dock path.
behaviors.public_action: Confirm Delete, then invoke scene-context Undo and Redo.
behaviors.expected_result: Delete chooses the same-index successor or prior final row, Undo selects the restored item, Redo restores the replacement, and an empty collection clears the editor.
invariants: The model and visible selected row refer to the same stable ID.
Focus is preserved only when the operation originated in that interface.
The command remains in the owning PVController scene history.
behaviors.notes: The focal verifies stable-ID row and dock recovery across Inspector-property replacement for Delete, Undo, and Redo, including focus ownership and teardown.

behaviors.precondition: A schema 2 FlowGraph satisfies its source validator and any legacy constructor payload receives the required explicit confirmation in chained steps.
behaviors.public_action: Call FlowGraphMigrator.migrate_schema_2_to_5().
behaviors.expected_result: The public 2→3→4→5 chain returns an independent validated schema 5 candidate and never mutates its source.
invariants: Every schema boundary remains explicit.
IDs, order, null positions, Variables, and invalid literal references are preserved according to their contracts.
A rejected step publishes no partial candidate.

behaviors.precondition: A runtime PVController enters a SceneTree with a valid schema 5 class definition or prepared inherited layout.
behaviors.public_action: Read, write, or reset an enabled INSTANCE attribute by stable ID and requester class ID.
behaviors.expected_result: Each controller owns an independent deeply detached value initialized from its definition default.
invariants: Definitions are never mutated.
Exact type, nullability, visibility, READONLY, and CONST rules are deterministic.
No Node, Resource, Callable, or static process-global store is retained.

behaviors.precondition: Controllers in one SceneTree resolve the same schema 5 declaring class.
behaviors.public_action: Acquire the class store and read, write, or reset a CLASS attribute by stable ID.
behaviors.expected_result: Controllers share one value only within SceneTree plus declaring class ID, retain it across scene changes, and lose it when that SceneTree ends.
invariants: Different SceneTrees and class IDs never share state.
A derived handle routes inherited CLASS slots to the declaring-class store.
Conflicting metadata rejects without resetting existing values.

behaviors.area: Schema 5 inherited attribute layout and access
behaviors.precondition: The active schema 5 graph and its saved ancestors resolve through a valid portable FlowClassCatalog.
behaviors.public_action: Resolve FlowRuntimeAttributeLayout and access slots with requester_class_id.
behaviors.expected_result: The effective layout is base→derived, each slot retains declaring_class_id, and access follows PUBLIC, PROTECTED, and PRIVATE rules.
invariants: A repeated stable ID anywhere in the hierarchy is an error.
A PRIVATE name on either side is an independent slot; PUBLIC/PROTECTED homonyms remain rejected.
Missing bases, cycles, excessive depth, and locator conflicts reject deterministically without mutation.

behaviors.precondition: An enabled PVController with a validated schema 3 graph enters the SceneTree.
behaviors.public_action: Allow PVController startup to invoke the Ready executor.
behaviors.expected_result: Enabled Ready processes execute their supported blocks once and emit console plus structured output in authored order.
invariants: Unsupported or invalid blocks are diagnosed and later blocks continue.
Definitions remain immutable.
Schema 5 never enters the schema 3 executor.

behaviors.precondition: A validated schema 3 container is executed with blocks using the default continuation or an ephemeral navigation decision.
behaviors.public_action: Execute the container through FlowReadyExecutor.
behaviors.expected_result: CONTINUE preserves linear order; JUMP resolves a stable target ID in the same container; STOP ends that path; invalid targets and accidental loops stop deterministically.
invariants: Existing output and method blocks retain default CONTINUE behavior.
The executor resolves navigation generically without knowing a concrete control-block type.
Navigation decisions and context are runtime-only and do not change schema or persistence.

behaviors.precondition: A valid schema 3 output-block container is authored through the normal Flujo Add controls.
behaviors.public_action: Add Custom Hello, persist and reload the graph or scene, then start the owning PVController.
behaviors.expected_result: The same registered concrete block survives persistence and emits Hola desde un bloque personalizado through the normal structured runtime output.
invariants: Print and Everything Flows continue through the same FlowOutputBlock execution contract.
The editor and executor contain no Custom-specific branch or dedicated control.
Stable block IDs, concrete script type, order, null positions, and schema 3 compatibility are preserved.

behaviors.precondition: An enabled schema 3 Timer has a finite positive interval and its PVController is enabled in the SceneTree.
behaviors.public_action: Start controller runtime and emit the internal Timer timeout.
behaviors.expected_result: One-shot or repeating Timers execute supported blocks in order and clean up their internal Timer nodes at shutdown.
invariants: Invalid or disabled Timers never start.
Runtime Timer nodes are not persisted into the authored scene.
Ready and Timer share the structured output boundary.

behaviors.precondition: A schema 3 PVController starts with enabled legacy Constructor blocks.
behaviors.public_action: Run the guarded controller startup sequence.
behaviors.expected_result: Constructor blocks execute exactly once immediately before Ready.
invariants: This is not Godot native _init.
Method calls inside Constructor remain unsupported and are skipped diagnostically.
Schema 4 and schema 5 declarative Constructor data is never executed through this path.

behaviors.precondition: A Ready or Timer Call Method block references an enabled starter Method by stable ID.
behaviors.public_action: Execute the containing Ready or Timer blocks.
behaviors.expected_result: The referenced Method executes its supported blocks once and returns control to the caller's next block.
invariants: Renaming does not alter the stable reference.
Missing, invalid, disabled, nested, or signature-bearing targets are diagnosed and skipped.
Arguments, returns, recursion, and method-to-method calls remain deferred.

behaviors.precondition: A v1 package manifest and its block descriptors are represented in memory without package discovery.
behaviors.public_action: Construct and validate FlowPackageManifest and FlowExternalBlockDescriptor values.
behaviors.expected_result: Valid required fields preserve order and derive package_id:type_id; empty, mismatched, duplicate, null, and unsupported-version data is rejected deterministically.
invariants: The descriptor layer does not parse JSON, discover packages, load scripts, instantiate blocks, or modify FlowBlockRegistry.
No IF-specific type, editor control, schema change, or runtime executor dependency is introduced.
The approved manifest fields are the only represented package contract in this foundation.

behaviors.precondition: A project-owned flow_packages fixture contains package directories and v1 manifest JSON files, including invalid siblings.
behaviors.public_action: Run FlowPackageManifestLoader.discover() against the project package root.
behaviors.expected_result: Packages are processed by sorted package_id, valid manifests and ordered descriptors are returned, and invalid packages produce deterministic diagnostics without preventing valid siblings.
invariants: Only manifest metadata is parsed; script existence, inheritance, loading and instantiation are deferred.
Relative script paths cannot escape their package through parent traversal.
The loader does not modify FlowBlockRegistry, editor state, runtime execution, schemas or package files.

behaviors.precondition: A metadata-valid package manifest references scripts inside its package, including valid and invalid resources.
behaviors.public_action: Run FlowExternalBlockScriptValidator.validate() for the discovered manifest.
behaviors.expected_result: Existing, loadable scripts deriving from FlowBlock are accepted; missing, non-Script, invalid, and non-FlowBlock resources receive deterministic diagnostics while later descriptors continue.
invariants: Validation uses script metadata and the existing get_base_script chain without retaining or registering instances.
No external type name, IF block, registry entry, editor control, runtime execution, or schema change is introduced.
Accepted descriptors remain in manifest order and diagnostics retain stable paths and package:type IDs.

behaviors.precondition: Integrated Registry entries and metadata/script-validated external manifests are available as ephemeral discovery results.
behaviors.public_action: Combine FlowBlockRegistry entries with valid external descriptors for authoring queries.
behaviors.expected_result: Integrated Print, Everything Flows, and Custom Hello entries remain first; valid external entries follow by package and manifest order with package:type_id keys.
invariants: Invalid metadata packages and invalid external scripts are excluded without preventing valid packages.
FlowBlockRegistry remains an integrated-block factory and contains no external package references.
The catalog does not modify popup/editor controls, instantiate blocks, execute runtime code, change schema, or know IF.

behaviors.precondition: A catalog entry comes from a metadata- and script-validated external descriptor inside a project-owned package.
behaviors.public_action: Ask FlowExternalBlockFactory to create one block from the external catalog entry.
behaviors.expected_result: The factory resolves and revalidates the declared script, calls Script.new(), returns a FlowBlock with a fresh stable ID and the descriptor display name, and rejects stale or non-external entries deterministically.
invariants: Each creation returns an independent instance and ID; no instance is retained, registered, executed, or serialized by the factory.
FlowBlockRegistry, FlowReadyExecutor, schema persistence, editor controls, and IF remain unaware of external creation.
A missing, invalid, unavailable, non-instantiable, or non-FlowBlock script produces diagnostics without affecting other catalog entries.

behaviors.area: Generic external block validation and duplication hooks
behaviors.precondition: A FlowGraph contains a FlowBlock subclass with optional structure checks or ID-addressed internal references.
behaviors.public_action: Validate the graph or duplicate it through the existing FlowGraph model API.
behaviors.expected_result: FlowBlock receives a validation context during graph validation and the complete old-ID → new-ID map during duplication; the base hooks remain no-op.
invariants: Existing built-in blocks retain their validation, persistence, and duplication behavior.
External hooks do not add schema fields, package registration, executor knowledge, or FlowIfBlock-specific behavior.
Stable IDs, ordering, null positions, and the source graph remain protected during duplication.

behaviors.precondition: A schema 3 supported container row is visible in the Godot Inspector and Fluo is configured for the same PVController.
behaviors.public_action: Activate the existing container row by double-click or Enter.
behaviors.expected_result: Fluo opens for that stable container ID with Flow visible, Flusso closed, and Flow focused on its first block or first Add-block button when empty.
invariants: The Inspector never creates a duplicate Blocks list.
The drawer reuses the live FlowGraph model instead of duplicating state.
Internal VP/PV class names are not renamed by the presentation change.
behaviors.notes: Manually exercised during Fluo Preview 1. No fresh final automated pass is claimed.

behaviors.area: Flusso live configuration and session revert
behaviors.precondition: A Flow block is selected and Flusso is open for that stable block ID.
behaviors.public_action: Modify supported configuration fields, press Revertir, or close Flusso with Escape/X.
behaviors.expected_result: Supported edits update the model immediately; Escape/X only closes; Revertir restores the persistent block configuration captured when the current Flusso session opened and keeps the panel open.
invariants: Closing Flusso does not decide whether an edit persists.
Revertir applies to configuration, not destructive structural deletion.
Closing Flusso restores keyboard focus to the same selected Flow block after any rebuild.

behaviors.precondition: Fluo is open and keyboard focus is inside the drawer.
behaviors.public_action: Use Up/Down, PageUp/PageDown, Ctrl+PageUp/PageDown, Alt+PageUp/PageDown, or Alt+Shift+PageUp/PageDown.
behaviors.expected_result: Up/Down follows the Flow list; Ctrl+Page keys cycle Flow blocks; plain Page keys cycle the current Inspector container view and synchronize its visible selection without moving keyboard focus out of Flow; Alt+Page keys cycle Flusso controls with Shift reversing direction.
invariants: Flow block navigation is circular by stable ID.
Inspector-level Page navigation closes stale Flusso options for the old container.
Repeated navigation remains usable after UI rebuilds because focus returns to Flow.

behaviors.area: Fluo drawer shell, close hierarchy and side placement
behaviors.precondition: The editor plugin has mounted one FluoDrawer on the Godot editor base.
behaviors.public_action: Open Fluo, toggle its side switch, close Flusso, close Fluo, or click outside the drawer.
behaviors.expected_result: One overlay drawer is reused, side placement changes immediately, first Escape closes Flusso when present, subsequent Escape/top X/exterior click closes Fluo, and valid prior focus can be restored.
invariants: The drawer does not permanently resize the legacy dock.
Backdrop input is consumed rather than leaked to editor controls underneath.
Touch-oriented close buttons keep their intended minimum target size.

behaviors.area: Fluo Preview 1 Android load and render
behaviors.precondition: The full-project preview for commit cd7e969c38193d718c948262107d1f7a45ca8083 is opened in Godot on Android.
behaviors.public_action: Open a supported container and display Fluo.
behaviors.expected_result: Godot loads the project and renders the Fluo drawer with Flow and Flusso visible without a project-load failure.
invariants: This evidence does not imply complete Android touch, orientation, scrolling, double-tap, or keyboard acceptance.
The tested code checkpoint remains traceable to the frozen preview backup branch.
behaviors.notes: Manual evidence recorded 2026-10-27 from the Android Godot preview screenshot supplied by the maintainer.
